Coram : VIKRAM NATH*, SATISH CHANDRA SHARMA
Issue for Consideration Whether in the facts and circumstances of the case, was it a fit case for exercising jurisdiction under Article 142(1) of the Constitution of India and pass a decree of divorce on the ground of irretrievable breakdown of marriage? Headnotes† Factors to be considered jurisdiction under Article 142(1) of the Constitution of India and pass a decree for divorce on the ground of irretrievable breakdown of marriage – Explained: Held: Both the Family Court and the High Court of Punjab and Haryana had dismissed the petition instituted by the Appellant
Decision Date : 06-05-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6088/2024 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
